_comment: Single source of truth for the app's Content-Security-Policy (issue #492).
Read by BOTH src/api/security_headers.py (Flask response header) and
frontend/vite.config.js (dev-server / preview response header). Keeping the
directive data in one file is deliberate: a policy that drifts between the
dev server and the API is a policy nobody trusts, and this repo's dominant
bug class is exactly that kind of two-sided name drift.
Rationale for every entry lives in docs/development/csp-rollout.md.
